title: One high singleton among low cards
author_notes: Reviewed during EC-033 implementation; see docs/COACHING_REVIEW.md. Independent hand; ratings are authored judgments, not probabilities or guaranteed outcomes.

feedback.title: The singleton can trap you
feedback.summary: The lone Spade King can become a forced winner. Mostly low cards do not make exactly zero safe.
points: Risk: when Spades are led, the King is your only card in that suit.
Conditional: the King can lose to the Ace, but you cannot assume the Ace takes it.
Trump is unknown; the other low cards do not remove this forced-play risk.

feedback.title: Avoid locking in zero
feedback.summary: Entering avoids a fragile zero commitment without pretending the King supports an opening bid.
points: The singleton King is conditional, not a guaranteed winner or loser.
Your many low cards make a large trick target unsupported.
Enter keeps participation open; no number or trump is chosen yet.
